mapper.update: UPDATE tb_comment SET like_count = like_count + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_comment SET like_count = GREATEST(like_count - 1, 0), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT c.*, b.title as blogTitle FROM tb_comment c LEFT JOIN tb_blog b ON c.blog_id = b.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
